sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Security Holographic Cold Foil Printing of Collectible Trading Cards

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Code monétaire et financier (Articles L. 561-2 et seq.), Ordonnance n° 2020-306 du 25 mars 2020 relative à la lutte contre le blanchiment des capitaux, des activités de financement du terrorisme et de la prolifération des armes de destruction massive, as amended by Law n° 2021-1754 of 23 December 2021; UBO register established by Décret n° 2021-1161 du 7 septembre 2021

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original birth certificate or passport of the UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent civil registry authority in the country of origin
Local government authority in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of no criminal record (if applicable)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent authority in the country of origin

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against PEP lists (French, EU, international), OFAC SDN list, UN sanctions list, and domestic French sanctions lists via tools compliant with AMF and ACPR standards

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: French language using Latin script; names must comply with French orthographic rules and avoid diacritics unless authorized
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Words implying public service or regulated activity without prior approval (e.g., 'banque', 'assurance', 'état')
Names identical or confusingly similar to existing companies or protected terms
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If name rejected, file an administrative appeal to the Président du Tribunal de Commerce within the prescribed delay; further recourse to the Tribunal Administratif if needed

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Accepted for non-regulated activities such as trading card printing; physical presence not strictly required but may be verified during inspections
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (routine compliance checks only; unannounced inspections rare for standard SARL entities)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO due diligence and beneficial ownership declaration preparation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for cross-border UBO screening

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French Ministry of Foreign Affairs or origin country embassy

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Professional legal services for pre-incorporation setup and compliance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing hourly rate for French corporate due diligence

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Articles L223-1 to L223-43 and R223-1 to R223-36 governing SARLs; Articles L123-1 et seq. governing the Registre National des Entreprises.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises operated by the Institut national de la propriété industrielle (INPI), with registration in the Registre National des Entreprises and, for commercial activities, the competent local Registre du commerce et des sociétés.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Electronic declaration of creation of a legal entity through the Guichet unique, accompanied by signed SARL articles of association and supporting documents; the historical M0 form is no longer the standard filing instrument.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital applies to a SARL. Capital is freely determined in the articles. At least 20% of cash contributions must be paid upon incorporation, with the balance payable within five years of registration. Contributions in kind must be fully transferred at incorporation. Funds may be deposited with a bank, notary, or Caisse des dépôts et consignations and released after registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The sole shareholder or shareholders resolve that the Company shall adopt the attached articles of association and subscribe the entire issued capital in accordance with them. The registered office is established at the address stated in the articles. The shareholders appoint [Name] as gérant for an indefinite term, subject to applicable law and the articles, and authorize the gérant to complete all incorporation, banking, tax, registry, beneficial-owner, employment, and licensing formalities. The gérant is authorized to open the Company’s bank account, receive released capital, execute ordinary formation documents, and make all filings necessary to commence the Company’s business.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Confirm shareholders, management, business purpose, and registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Confirm the shareholders, capital allocation, gérant, French registered office, legal name, duration, and precise corporate purpose. Obtain written occupancy evidence for the registered office. Ensure the collectible-card printing and trading activities are accurately described and do not imply regulated activities not actually performed.
required_dossiers: Gérant identification and declaration of non-conviction and filiation
Proposed company name and corporate purpose
Power of attorney, if filed by an agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct inconsistencies before submission; obtain a replacement address document or amended power of attorney where required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execute articles and deposit share capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Bank, notary, or Caisse des dépôts et consignations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the French-language articles of association. Deposit at least 20% of cash contributions into a blocked capital account and obtain the certificate of deposit. Complete any in-kind contribution valuation and transfer documentation. A commissaire aux apports report is generally required unless all statutory exemption conditions are satisfied.
required_dossiers: In-kind contribution report or exemption decision, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Resolve bank identification or source-of-funds queries, replace defective signatures, and obtain corrected deposit evidence before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Authorized legal-announcement publication service in the department of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the legally required constitution notice containing the company name, legal form, capital, registered office, purpose, duration, gérant details, and applicable registration information. Retain the publication certificate. Use an authorized service listed for the relevant French department.
required_dossiers: Final articles or verified incorporation data
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Republish a corrected notice if the service identifies a statutory omission or typographical error and upload the replacement certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File the creation application and beneficial-owner declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet unique; registration processed through the Registre National des Entreprises and competent Registre du commerce et des sociétés
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the electronic creation formalité, upload the signed documents, identify beneficial owners, select the commercial activity, pay the applicable charges, and electronically sign the filing. Verify that the activity description, establishment address, tax options, and gérant information match all supporting documents.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond through the Guichet unique within the stated deadline, upload corrected documents, pay any additional charge, and resubmit the queried formalité without changing unrelated data.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Complete post-registration governance and tax onboarding
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Service des impôts des entreprises, URSSAF, and relevant commercial bank; INPI for subsequent corporate changes
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain the SIREN, SIRET, and APE code; activate the business tax account; confirm VAT and corporate-income-tax settings; release deposited capital; maintain the share register and decisions register; and register as an employer before hiring. Adopt written shareholder and management records for material decisions.
required_dossiers: Employer registration documents, if employees are hired
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: File corrections with the relevant authority, submit missing tax or social-security forms, and document any delay or rejected registration in the corporate records.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No general industrial licensing board applies to collectible trading-card publishing, trading, or ordinary printing. Where the premises or processes fall within the classified-installations regime, the competent authority is the Préfet of the department, supported by the Direction régionale de l’environnement, de l’aménagement et du logement (DREAL).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No general operating or manufacturing permit. An ICPE declaration, registration, or authorization may be required for printing, ink, solvent, storage, combustion, or waste activities meeting the applicable nomenclature thresholds.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry for Ecological Transition, administered locally through the Préfecture and DREAL
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Generally exempt from a project-specific full EIA for ordinary card trading and small-scale printing; conditional ICPE declaration, registration, authorization, or environmental assessment applies if process capacity, solvent or ink quantities, emissions, waste, or site characteristics reach statutory thresholds.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Comply with applicable ICPE prescriptions, the Water Code, hazardous-waste rules, waste-traceability requirements, and VOC controls. Prevent unauthorized wastewater discharge, segregate and transfer solvent or ink residues to authorized operators, maintain safety data sheets, and apply any site-specific emission limits imposed by the prefectural order.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No general pre-opening occupational clearance is required for a private production or warehouse site. If the premises receive the public, obtain applicable établissement recevant du public fire-safety and accessibility approval from the mairie and consult the Service départemental d’incendie et de secours. The employer must assess occupational risks, prepare the DUERP, implement machine, chemical, fire, electrical, and emergency controls, and satisfy applicable Labour Code requirements. Structural-load and electrical inspections are required where dictated by the building, equipment, insurer, or applicable safety rules.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFIP) — portal: impots.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Register the SARL with the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce via the online Registre National des Entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr); obtain the K-bis extraction, SIREN (9-digit) and SIRET (14-digit) identification codes; the DGFIP automatically allocates a French VAT number (format FR + 2-digit key + SIREN) upon tax registration; request an intra-community VAT number and EORI number for customs via the DGFIP's Service des Impôts des Entreprises.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Not a check-the-box jurisdiction. Available elections: (a) option for SARLs meeting CGI Art. 239 bis AA conditions to be taxed quasi-transparently under personal income tax (IR); (b) VAT group registration (assujetti résultant d'un groupement) under CGI Art. 257 C; (c) corporate income tax consolidation (régime d'intégration fiscale) under CGI Art. 223 A for French wholly-owned subsidiaries; (d) DAC6/MDR disclosure for hybrid mismatch arrangements.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Non-established foreign suppliers: EUR 0 threshold (VAT registration required from the first taxable transaction unless the Import One-Stop-Shop applies for consignment imports ≤ EUR 150). French-established SMEs: annual turnover exemption threshold of EUR 85,000 for goods and EUR 37,500 for services (CGI Art. 293 B). Intra-EC distance sales threshold: EUR 10,000 for supplies to French consumers if the supplier is EU-established.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory e-invoicing and e-reporting will be phased in from 1 September 2026 (large and mid-sized enterprises) and 1 September 2027 (small enterprises). The DGFIP operates the Chorus Pro public portal; e-invoices must use structured XML formats (Factur-X, UBL or CII) and be transmitted via certified Plateformes de Dématérialisation Partenaires using API or direct EDI. No digital fiscal stamp or real-time transaction clearance; periodic e-reporting of transaction data to DGFIP.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods to non-EU third countries are zero-rated (exonération à l'export) under CGI Art. 262 II, provided the goods are physically dispatched or transported out of the EU by the seller or on its behalf within one year (three months for means of transport). Supplies of services directly related to exported goods (including printing and production of collectible cards for export) qualify for 0% when the services are linked to tangible property placed under external transit or customs-union regime. Intra-Community supplies to a VAT-registered EU customer are taxed at 0% subject to valid French and customer VAT IDs and EC sales list filing.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Déclaration d'Échanges de Marchandises via DELTA / DAE)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill issued to the French exporter
Inward Remittance Certificate (or equivalent bank payment confirmation)
Commercial Invoice and packing list referencing the DAE and destination incoterms
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGFIP may claim late interest at 0.20% per month plus penalties of 40% (mauvaise foi) or 80% (manoeuvre frauduleuse) where export evidence is insufficient or fraudulent. In aggravated tax fraud cases criminal penalties can reach EUR 750,000 fine and ten years imprisonment. Export zero-rating may be retrospectively clawed back from the first transaction in the reassessment period; the ordinary reassessment statute is six years, extended to ten years for unreported foreign activity.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Bank of France), acting within the European System of Central Banks and the Single Supervisory Mechanism; prudential oversight delegated to the Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution (ACPR); foreign exchange and balance-of-payments administration governed by the French Monetary and Financial Code and EU Capital Movement Directives.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full capital and current account convertibility applies to EUR as the domestic currency within the eurozone; France imposes no general exchange control authorization for inbound equity or outbound trade payments. Direct investment and cross-border financial transfers are unrestricted but must comply with statistical reporting to Banque de France (balance-of-payments declarations such as the 'Déclaration de flux' for transactions exceeding €15,000 per calendar month or as otherwise threshold-triggered). Profit remittance via dividends is freely convertible and transferable, subject to corporate income tax withholding (28% standard rate, reduced to 0-15% under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive or applicable double tax treaty) and to anti-artificial-avoidance rules. No administrative pre-approval is required for FX conversion, but banks require full underlying documentation for source-of-funds verification.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender requirement applies in France; there is no mandatory period for converting export receipts into EUR and no prescribed conversion ratio. Export proceeds may be retained in foreign currency bank accounts subject to Banque de France statistical declaration obligations for balance-of-payments reporting when aggregate flows exceed the regulatory threshold (€15,000 per month). For a French SARL active in collectible trading card exports, receipts denominated in USD or GBP can remain offshore or in EUR-denominated accounts without forced conversion, though corporate treasury policy should match currency exposure with permitted hedging instruments.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium. An EU-licensed Electronic Money Institution (EMI), including a French entity licensed by the ACPR or an EU entity passporting into France under PSD2, can open accounts and issue IBANs without local banking branch presence; such EMIs are viable for receivables collection from global card buyers and for low-value disbursements. Offshore digital EMIs domiciled outside the EU are not permitted to provide payment accounts or clearing services to a French SARL without a passport or an agent/licensing arrangement in France; use of such providers creates AML/CTF and regulatory compliance risk and should be avoided for core treasury operations. All EMIs must perform Beneficial Ownership (UBO) declarations and may restrict settlement in high-risk jurisdictions.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of at least one corporate director or the individual having signature authority is effectively mandatory at account opening for tier-1 French banks; most institutions require an in-person interview at a French branch to verify identity, sign mandates, and complete the ACPR-compliant KYC file. Remote opening via videoconference is permitted by French AML regulations and has been adopted by certain banks and EMIs, but it requires notarized corporate documents (extrait K-bis, statuts, pouvoir), biometric identity verification, and may still demand a subsequent physical visit for activating payment or card services. The SARL's gérant must be prepared to attend in person; a French-resident representative or delegated signatory should be appointed to avoid operational delay.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) or foreign holding company in the ownership chain, especially in low- or non-cooperative tax jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Extrait K-bis (less than 3 months old), certified articles of association (statuts), full UBO declaration (Déclaration de bénéficiaires effectifs) filed with the Registre du Commerce, organizational chart of the ownership group, certified passports of UBOs, sworn source-of-wealth documentation (bank statements, audited financial statements, tax returns) covering the capital contribution, and a written group structure rationale letter.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume or high-value cross-border wire traffic in the first 6–12 months inconsistent with projected business volume or target market geography
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial contracts with distributors and marketplaces, platform payout statements (e.g., Stripe, Amazon), proforma invoices and purchase orders, logistics and customs documentation, carrier waybills, and a treasury narrative explaining trade flows; all documents must be consistent with the NAF/APE code declared at registration.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Business description involving holographic printing, security features, or collectible intellectual property that appears unusual for the bank's standard merchant risk taxonomy
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Business plan detailing manufacturing and sourcing partners, proofs of intellectual property ownership or licensing agreements (trademark certificates, licensing contracts), samples of registered trading card product lines, website and marketplace storefront evidence, and confirmation that no special statutory license is required (with legal opinion if requested).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid onboarding of multiple signatories or frequent subsequent addition of mandate holders (dual-control access requests)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized board or shareholder resolutions approving signatory appointments, certified copies of identity documents of all mandate holders, updated extrait K-bis, and a signed internal authorization matrix documenting segregation of duties and maximum transaction limits.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of offshore digital EMI or intermediary payment processors creating an opaque settlement trail before funds reach the French bank
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Regulatory status evidence of the EMI (licence number and regulatory register), the contractual master service agreement with the payment processor, complete transaction-level reporting/ledger exports, and a written undertaking to settle exclusively through the French corporate bank account after the onboarding phase.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant injection of equity capital into the French SARL is executed through SWIFT MT103 with Sender-to-Reference purpose code indicating 'Capital contribution – constitution or increase of capital' (OECD purpose category E001/E002; French balance-of-payments code '221' for direct investment); the remitting bank must be a corresponding bank of the receiving French bank, and the beneficiary account should be a specifically designated Capital Escrow Account pending legal completion of the share capital increase. Verification includes the notarized minutes of the shareholder resolution, the updated statuts, the deposit certificate (attestation de dépôt de fonds) from the escrow bank or notary, and the UBO declaration. Inbound transfers from non-EU jurisdictions exceeding €50,000 are systematically escalated for source-of-funds review; funds should originate from the corporate account of the direct shareholder and be supported by audited financial statements or dividend certificates to demonstrate legitimate provenance. No FX approval is required for EUR-denominated injections, but USD or other converted currencies must be swapped under transparent execution with no obscuring conversion.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements for procurement of printing materials, manufacturing services, and third-party production use SWIFT MT103 (customer credit transfer) for open-account supplier payments and MT202/MT202COV for interbank cover payments; large purchase orders or new supplier relationships should be supported by a Commercial Letter of Credit (MT700 series) to mitigate counterparty risk, particularly for holographic film and security substrate suppliers. Intra-EU payments in EUR execute via the SEPA Credit Transfer (SCT) scheme settled through TARGET2, providing same-day clearing; non-EUR trade payments (USD, GBP, CNY) settle via correspondent banking through CHIPS/Fedwire, with daylight overdraft and FX processing determined by the French corporate bank's conversion desk. For recurring royalty or licensing disbursements to non-resident rights holders, execute MT103 with the appropriate purpose code (e.g., 'IP royalties') and retain withholding tax certificates (attestation de précompte) and double-tax-treaty relief forms (formulaires Cerfa 5000-series) in the treasury file to ensure clean auditability.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX Forward (EUR/USD, EUR/GBP, EUR/CNY) — executed with the same-tier French corporate bank under an ISDA 2002 Master Agreement and Credit Support Annex, available only with documented underlying trade exposure.
FX Swap (swap de change) for short-term liquidity conversion between EUR and export proceeds currencies, permitted for treasury cash management.
Cross-Currency Swap (fixed-to-fixed or floating-to-fixed) for hedging multi-year non-EUR monetary liabilities or receivables.
Vanilla European FX Options (EUR/USD puts/calls) allowed for hedging of forecasted export revenues, subject to the bank's derivatives eligibility and suitability assessment.
Flexible Forward (window forward) — permitted as a variation of the deliverable forward, allowing partial monthly drawings against a single trade flow.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements (bilan, compte de résultat, annexe) approved by shareholders and filed with the commercial registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (via guichet unique entreprises)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Fiscal year-end plus 6 months for shareholder approval; filing with the registry within 1 month after approval. Calendar-year SARL: approval by 30 June and filing by 31 July, unless a court-approved extension up to 6 additional months is granted.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Civil fine up to EUR 1,500 for omission; late-filing penalty EUR 45–75 per month of delay; potential judicial strike-off after one missed fiscal year; registration of a public alert for non-publication of accounts.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation of beneficial owner (UBO) declaration and supporting identity evidence
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (RCS file)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days following the anniversary of the initial RCS registration or of the last UBO declaration change; yearly confirmation is required even when no change has occurred.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal fine up to EUR 15,000 for the legal entity and up to EUR 7,500 for individuals, with possible imprisonment up to 6 months; the registry may initiate strike-off procedures.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (liasse fiscale: IS forms 2065 and 2052–2059) with profit/loss statement
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) – Service des Impôts des Entreprises
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For calendar-year taxpayers: electronic filing by 3 May of the following year (or the next working day if 3 May is non-business); for non-calendar fiscal years: within 3 months of fiscal year-end, with a possible 3-month extension.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of 10% of amounts due if paid within 30 days of the notice, otherwise 40% in case of bad faith; late-payment interest 0.20% per month; possible additional penalties for false or incomplete declarations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Cotisation Foncière des Entreprises (CFE) annual return and payment (local business property contribution)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGFiP / municipal tax office via professional online account (impots.gouv.fr)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Initial return (form 1447-C) within 3 months of activity creation or change; annual tax notice is payable by 15 November of the year of assessment, extended to 15 December for electronic-payment businesses; recurring CFE declaration due together with the annual VAT reconciliation on 5 May for businesses filing electronically.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% late-payment surcharge plus 0.40% monthly late interest; enforcement by DGFiP; unpaid CFE may lead to seizure and additional penalties up to 40% in cases of fraud.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit (commissaire aux comptes) for a French SARL when at least two of the three following thresholds are exceeded at the close of the fiscal year: total balance sheet exceeding EUR 4,000,000; net turnover exceeding EUR 8,000,000; average employed workforce exceeding 50 employees. Audit is also required when the SARL controls another company exceeding these thresholds or when the SARL is a holding entity with certain statutory conditions.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French generally accepted accounting principles (PCG / ANC Regulation 2014-03) with mandatory tax-basis reconciliation; IFRS is permitted only for consolidated financial statements and is not used for the individual statutory annual accounts of an SARL.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The legal representative must file a signed annual declaration confirming the identity, nationality, date of birth, and private address of each ultimate beneficial owner, together with supporting copies, every year within 30 days after the anniversary of the RCS registration or of the last UBO update. The confirmation is mandatory even in the absence of any shareholding transfer or change, and any modification must be declared within 15 days.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members / shareholding movement register (registre des mouvements de titres)
Register of Directors (register of decisions and meetings of the manager)
Minute Book (registre des décisions d'associé and general assembly minutes)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 180 – USD 720 per year (EUR 150–600) for a registered office address and professional corporate agent service
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 6,500 – USD 19,500 (EUR 5,500–16,000) for a statutory audit of a small-to-medium SARL engaged in collectible-trading-card publishing, including the statutory audit report and related-party control procedures
